changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdiagnostictestnormalrange AS SELECT dtnr.id, dtnr.profile_test_id, dtnr.test_id, dtnr.gender, dtnr.age_from, dtnr.age_from_unit, dtnr.age_to, dtnr.age_to_unit, dtnr.condition, dtnr.result_text, dtnr.result_lov, dtnr.normal_range_type, dtnr.range_from, dtnr.range_to, dtnr.critical_value, dtnr.critical_value_less_than, dtnr.critical_value_more_than FROM public.diagnostic_test_normal_range dtnr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestnormalrange TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdiagnostictestnormalrange FROM report_user;
